calls.title: Elyse Fox and Kevin Travers
calls.summary: The team aimed to improve the storyboard visuals to better align with intended messaging and simplify complexity. Key discussions included integrating logos to demonstrate a unified code output, emphasizing safety, speed, and insight through animated text, and reducing visual clutter. They agreed on a minimalist design for logos and UI elements targeting knowledgeable users. The conversation also covered depicting staged feature rollouts with performance metrics, clear A/B testing visuals, and the animation of final results. They established a timeline for the final storyboard draft by March 3rd and video submission by March 6th while stressing the importance of detailed feedback and clarity in communication.
calls.keywords: Storyboard, Animation, Feature Rollout, AB Experimentation, UI Simplification, Auto-Rollback
calls.action_items:
**Elyse Fox**
Provide written detailed feedback and guidance on storyboard simplification and text usage by afternoon of meeting day (18:51)
Deliver simplified screenshot or visual for the Claude Sonnet by Anthropic logo section to aid minimalistic design (11:06)
Supply clear, detailed instructions and marked-up examples regarding UX for rollout stages, auto-rollback, and AB experimentation concepts (12:13)
Submit textual and visual tweaks to clarify UI segments and streamline storyboarding elements (16:55)

**Kevin Travers**
Begin animating video sections that are finalized or close to final, such as logo animations and feature three, to keep project on schedule (19:02)
Review and integrate Elyse’s upcoming detailed feedback and screenshots to refine storyboard and animation accordingly (00:00)
Coordinate with animation team to implement staggered text appearances and visual emphasis on key terms (09:23)
